stem: In the figure, point \(D\) lies on \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{BD}\) is perpendicular to \(\overline{AC}\). \(AB = 10\), \(BC = 17\), and \(BD = 8\). What is the value of \(\cos(\angle ACB)\)?
solution: Angle \(ACB\) is an acute angle of right triangle \(BDC\), whose hypotenuse is \(BC = 17\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. \(\frac{8}{17}\) is \(\sin(\angle ACB)\), the opposite leg \(BD\) over the hypotenuse.
explanation.C: Incorrect. \(\frac{3}{5} = \frac{6}{10}\) is \(\cos(\angle BAC)\), the cosine of the angle at \(A\), not at \(C\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. \(\frac{15}{8}\) is \(\frac{DC}{BD}\), the adjacent leg over the opposite leg; a cosine uses the hypotenuse and cannot exceed 1.

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert d('A','B')==10 and d('B','C')==17 and d('B','D')==8 and abs(ang('B','D','C')-90)<0.1
dc=sqrt(17**2-8**2)
ans=dc/17
assert dc==15 and ans==Rational(15,17) and abs(cos(ang('A','C','B')*pi/180)-ans)<1e-6
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert value(choices['C'])==d('A','D')/d('A','B')
assert all(simplify(value(choices[k])-ans)!=0 for k in choices if k!=answer)
